definitions.gloss: to parade, to march in procession
definitions.explanation: To walk slowly and deliberately in a group through streets or an area, typically as part of a festival, celebration, or demonstration.

examples.japanese: ⟦{神輿|みこし}→神輿：10605_mikoshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{担|かつ}いで→担ぐ：03917_katsugu⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{練|ね}り{歩|ある}く。
examples.english: They parade through town carrying the portable shrine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仮装|かそう}した→仮装する：25384_kasousuru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{通|とお}り→通り：01475_toori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{練|ね}り{歩|ある}いた。
examples.english: People in costumes paraded through the street.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祭|まつ}り→祭り：03735_matsuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{山車|だし}→山車：12405_dashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{商店街|しょうてんがい}→商店街：09391_shoutengai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{練|ね}り{歩|ある}き、⟦{沿道|えんどう}→沿道：13270_endou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{観客|かんきゃく}→観客：02556_kankyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦にぎやか→にぎやか：00873_nigiyaka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げた→上げる：02443_ageru⟧。
examples.english: On the festival day, floats paraded through the shopping street, and spectators along the route cheered loudly.

notes:
Godan verb ({五段動詞|ごだんどうし}), く-ending.
- Negative: {練|ね}り{歩|ある}かない
- Polite: {練|ね}り{歩|ある}きます
- Te-form: {練|ね}り{歩|ある}いて
- Past: {練|ね}り{歩|ある}いた

USAGE:
Often associated with festivals (⟦{祭|まつ}り→祭り：03735_matsuri⟧), processions, and demonstrations. The ⟦{練|ね}り→練る：09751_neru⟧ component implies a slow, deliberate, stately movement rather than ordinary walking.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{練|ね}り{歩|ある}く: to parade through town
- ⟦{通|とお}り→通り：01475_toori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{練|ね}り{歩|ある}く: to march along the street
- ⟦{神輿|みこし}→神輿：10605_mikoshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{担|かつ}いで→担ぐ：03917_katsugu⟧{練|ね}り{歩|ある}く: to parade carrying a portable shrine
